{{Quote|We stay neutral, so you don't have to.|GSI motto|<ref name="Developer" />}}
'''Galactic Solutions Industries''' (GSI) was a weapons manufacturing company, founded by inventor and business tycoon [[Addalar Hyland]] as the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A neutral corporation, GSI dealt weapons to both governments, and frequently hired various individuals to aid its many research divisions in their efforts to develop new weapons technologies and military gear. Those individuals who completed multiple assignments for GSI were qualified for the company's [[Valued Partner Initiative]], which rewarded them with discounts and access to special items.

The company was still in business during the [[New Sith Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] over two thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after GSI's founding, and the company's [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistols]] were favorites of a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] in the Sith [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].

==History==
Galactic Solutions Industries was founded by [[Addalar Hyland]], a well-known inventor and business tycoon, also known for creating [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization|THORN]], around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> as the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Based in the [[Galactic Solutions Industries Headquarters|GSI Headquarters]] on the [[Promenade]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], GSI soon became a popular source of weaponry, and the company's first product&mdash;the [[GSI-B4 blaster pistol|GSI-B4]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]&mdash;was praised for its impressive firepower compared to its small size as an easily concealed holdout weapon.<ref name="Codex" />
[[File:GSI_speeder.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Speeder showroom at the GSI Headquarters on Nar Shaddaa]]
As war resumed, GSI remained neutral and did business with both the Republic and the Empire, and it often recruited various combatants on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to aid in the company's research and resource gathering.<ref name="Codex" /> GSI maintained a number of weapons research divisions, including their [[Animal Weaponization Division|Animal Weaponization]],<ref name="Krayt" /> [[Biodesign Division|Biodesign]],<ref name="Makrin" /> [[Metallurgical Division|Metallurgical]],<ref name="Rare Metals" /> [[Natural Weapons Division|Natural Weapons]],<ref name="Weather Tower" /> [[Starfighter Division|Starfighter]],<ref name="Hazardous Materials" /> and [[Superweapons Division]]s.<ref name="Data Recovery" /> Another notable subsidiary of GSI was abbreviated the same way [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], which conducted environmental research.<ref name="institute" /> Employees of the company typically wore GSI's colors of white, orange, and light blue, used both on uniforms and on armor.<ref name="ROTHC" />

GSI sent numerous probes to conduct surveys of various planets across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], in search for valuable resources and opportunities for research. The company often provided their contractors with access to the survey data, pinpointing areas on the planets where a close range scan with the help of a [[Subterranean Seeker Droid]] might reveal buried treasures.<ref name="Seeker Droid surveys">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|GSI survey probes, seen via [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]}}</ref>

===Alderaan===
On the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], GSI's [[Natural Weapons Division]] sought to acquire technology in Alderaan's [[Weather tower|weather towers]] that could aid in the construction of a "Weather Dominator" prototype, and because the rights to the technology were in dispute, the company recruited various individuals to acquire scans of the towers so that they could reverse-engineer it.<ref name="Weather Tower" /> GSI also fitted several [[Giant Red thranta]]s, endangered flying Alderaanian creatures, with GSI surveillance technology to gather data on troop deployments in the ongoing [[Alderaan Civil War]], and recruited various individuals to retrieve the data.<ref name="Alderaan Data Recovery">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Surveillance Data Recovery|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> The independent intelligence operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] hired a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to steal GSI weapons technology from the company's [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]], and the company traced the perpetrator to one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]]'s communications networks. After GSI contractors located and defeated the thief, the company's [[Recovery Division]] was able to reacquire the technology.<ref name="Saboteur at Large">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsiact|Saboteur at Large|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

Upon learning that [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] had buried radioactive waste on Alderaan years earlier instead of following proper disposal protocols in order to save money, GSI initiated orbital scans of the planet to locate the waste as it was a potential fuel source. Finding that the native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] had built nests over the dump sites, GSI hired individuals to retrieve the waste barrels from the area, and the company's [[Starfighter Division]] made use of the barrels to power new designs.<ref name="Hazardous Materials" /> The Killiks themselves also drew the interest of GSI, as their hive mind produced hybrid weapons using the collective knowledge of dozens of individuals from various civilizations. GSI sent contractors to retrieve those weapons from where they were buried underneath Killik memorials on Alderaan.<ref name="Weapons Testing">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Weapons Testing|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

===Hoth===
The ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] possessed a unique combination of electromagnetic fields and gravitational pull that often caused [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to crash on its surface, and GSI's Natural Weapons Division employed outside aid in examining the wreckage across the planet in hopes of reverse-engineering the circumstances in which the ships crashed.<ref name="Crash Site">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Crash Site Readings|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> The crash site of the ''[[Ambria's Fury]]'' drew the company's especial attention when it was discovered that leaking radiation from the ship's core had mutated the [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plating into what they believed could be a material useful in the construction of thermonuclear weaponry, and GSI sent contractors to retrieve samples from the heavily irradiated wreckage.<ref name="Irradiated">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Irradiated Durasteel Samples|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> Another crash site belonged to the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who stole sensitive research from GSI's Superweapons Division, but crashed on their return to Hoth, leading GSI to hire individuals to retrieve the data from the crash site.<ref name="Data Recovery" /> 

A starship of unknown origin was discovered frozen underneath ice spires and drew the attention of the company, which tasked its contractors to recover components of the vessel for their Starfighter Division.<ref name="Debris">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Unidentified Ship Debris|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> GSI also sought to acquire samples of [[Embersteel/Legends|embersteel]], a metallic compound that formed when metallic ores were melted by lava vents, warped by Hoth's electromagnetic fields, and then instantly cooled by Hoth's icy temperatures. The company forwarded the coordinates of volcanic activity to contractors equipped with [[Subterranean Seeker Droid|GSI seeker droids]], to take samples of the ore from within mini-volcanoes that lined the floor of the [[Glacial Fissure]], as they suspected embersteel could be useful in the construction of [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]].<ref name="Embersteel">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Embersteel Samples|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

===Tatooine===
When a meteoroid broke up over the desert planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], GSI's orbital sensors detected the energy signature of a particularly dense and rare variant of the material [[phobium]]. The company hired individuals to locate and scan the fragments in order to determine whether the fragments could be useful in the construction of fuel cells.<ref name="Space Debris">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Space Debris Removal|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> A shipment of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] repair [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was lost on Tatooine and scavenged by the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], and because of sandstorm activity in the area, the company hired individuals to pinpoint Jawa [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]] so that GSI could send retrieval units.<ref name="Scavenged Prototypes">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Scavenged Prototypes|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> GSI's [[Animal Weaponization Division]] sought outside help in recovering eggs from Tatooine's native [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], the largest and most feared creature in Tatooine's entire ecosystem, so that they could potentially clone the creatures and conduct tests in laboratory settings. The company advised the searchers to look for [[penakin]] larvae, which fed on the nutrients from krayt dragon egg fossils.<ref name="Krayt" />

[[File:GSI-RogueDroid-SWTOR.png|thumb|A GSI rogue battle droid]]
GSI also sought to develop portable [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] for use in military settings, and their contractors took detailed scans of the the scaled-down vaporators used by Tatooine's settlers in cliff and mesa settlements across the planet.<ref name="Vaporators">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Examine Vaporators|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Some of GSI's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] prototypes were stolen in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and in [[Mos Ila|Mos Ila]] by a thief on Tatooine, and because the thief was using [[subsurface scrambler]]s to hide the droids' location, GSI sought outside aid in locating and destroying the droids so that the company's technology would not be copied.<ref name="Rogue Droid">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsiact|Rogue Droid|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

===Makeb===
When the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Conquest of Makeb|conquered]] the remote world of [[Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], GSI began investigating the planet for potential research opportunities, and the company hired individuals to scan the advanced transmission towers around the [[Sanctuary research complex]] on Makeb so that they could replicate the technology.<ref name="Encryption">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Encryption Coding|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> GSI's [[Metallurgical Division]] sought to procure samples of the metal used in the Hutt Cartel's advanced [[isotope-5 droid]]s, an alloy that consisted of rare metals only found in the caverns of Makeb's volcanic mesas. The company accordingly sent contractors to recover samples of the metals from the caverns so that they could use the alloy for their own battle droids and weapons.<ref name="Rare Metals" /> GSI also sought to acquire the schematics for the isotope-5 droids, leading them to hire various individuals to retrieve the schematics from Cartel-allied mercenaries on Makeb.<ref name="Schematics">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsiact|Prototype Schematics|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

[[Makeb]]'s proclivity towards severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] saw [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] try to create a system of subterranean vibration emitters that were intended to cancel out seismic tremors, and though the project failed, GSI believed that they could turn the devices into weapons that would cause groundquakes, so the company hired individuals to locate and excavate the emitters.<ref name="Groundquake">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=gsireq|Groundquake Technology|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> Makeb's [[makrin creeper]] interested GSI's [[Biodesign Division]], which tasked contractors to retrieve makrin [[protobark]]&mdash;the casings in which the tree-like makrin develops underground&mdash;so that they could research the creation of damage-resistant wilderness gear.<ref name="Makrin" />

===Ziost===
[[File:HR-02 Omni Droid.png|thumb|[[HR-02 Omni Droid]]]]
In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date 3.2">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> Galactic Solutions Industries had a presence on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], where the company was studying geomagnetic subsurface pulses<ref name="Dead Pulse">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=daily|Dead Pulse|[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]}}</ref> and was conducting a project of holo-reconstruction of an ancient [[Emperor's Eye (temple)|Sith Temple]], using [[HR-02 Omni Droid]]s. Droids' high power consumption stagnated the project, and by the time [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]] [[Ziost crisis|obliterated all life]] on the planet, it still wasn't finished.<ref name="Eyes into the Past">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=daily|Eyes into the Past|[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]}}</ref> GSI [[Ziost Analysis Services Center|Ziost orbital station]] was used as a hub for both [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] agents during the preceding crisis, and it retained this role after the catastrophe.<ref name="Rise" />

With [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] devastated, GSI became interested in collecting any surviving audo-visual recordings of the last days of planet's life, generously paying to those who could acquire them for the company.<ref name="Ziost Memory">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=other|Ziost Memory Holographs}}</ref>  At the same time they sent in their contractors to the surface, to collect data on the genetic effect of the mass [[Force drain/Legends|Force Drain]] unleashed by [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]], hoping to recreate it in lab conditions.<ref name="From Ashes">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=daily|From Ashes|[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]}}</ref>

===Dantooine===
In [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> when an advanced bio-[[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]] [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], ship's automatic systems, built to accommodate the exotic life-forms onboard, [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the [[Jannimak crash site|area]] surrounding the crash. The phenomena occurring at the crash site got GSI's attention, and the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], a subsidiary of Galactic Solutions Industries, sent in their scientists to investigate. Lead by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pordav]] and assisted by GSI contractors, they conducted various research.<ref name="wreckage">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

===New Sith Wars===
The company still existed several thousand years later by the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] factions.<ref name="PoD" />

==Products==
[[File:GSI_HQ.jpg|thumb|right|240px|A number of GSI products on display at the company's headquarters]]
Galactic Solutions Industries was primarily a weapons manufacturer, and its first product was the critically praised GSI-B4 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol.<ref name="Codex" /> The company also branched out into a wide variety of weapon technologies, from biological weapons<ref name="Krayt" /> and battle droids<ref name="Rogue Droid" /> to starfighters<ref name="Hazardous Materials" /> and superweapons,<ref name="Data Recovery" /> such as the [[The Spike (weapon)|Spike]], a massive drilling device that saw utilization by [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization|THORN]] to dig into [[Rakghoul|rakghoul]] [[Rakghoul tunnels|tunnels]] during the galaxy-wide [[Rakghoul pandemic|pandemic]].<ref name="spike" />

GSI also developed and manufactured military support technology such as advanced fuel cells<ref name="Vaporators" /> and portable [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporators]].<ref name="Vaporators" /> A notable product developed by GSI was a series of advanced [[Subterranean Seeker Droid]]s, an excavating technology notably used by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] during the [[Seeds of Rage|hunt for Seeds of Rage]], to uncover the Seeds from the sites all over the Galaxy.<ref name="Seeker Droid Missions" />

By the time of the New Sith Wars, two of GSI's products were the [[GSI-21D]]<ref name="PoD" /> and [[GSI-24D disruptor pistol|GSI-24D]]<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistols]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Gloom Walkers]], a [[unit]] in the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]' [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]], preferred to use Galactic Solutions Industries products.<ref name="PoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galactic Solutions Industries was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and released on [[September 26]], [[2006]]. The company was later featured in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where GSI issues missions on Makeb, Alderaan, Tatooine, and Hoth for players who possess [[EV2 discreet reconnaissance macrobinoculars]] and [[Subterranean Seeker Droid|Seeker Droids]].<ref name="ROTHC" />
